A clean, flat textbook illustration showing the six days of creation in a grid of six panels. Panel 1: A striking contrast of bright golden light breaking through dark shadows. Panel 2: A clear blue sky separating clouds above from blue water below. Panel 3: Green rolling hills, trees with fruit, and blue seas. Panel 4: A bright sun, a crescent moon, and twinkling stars in space. Panel 5: Fish leaping from water and birds flying in the sky. Panel 6: Various land animals (lion, elephant, cattle) and the silhouettes of a man and woman standing together on the grass. White background.

A scene in an ancient Middle Eastern workshop. A bearded potter sitting at a stone wheel, shaping a lump of wet brown clay with wet, muddy hands. Beside him, an assortment of finished clay jars and pots. In the background, a man (representing the prophet Jeremiah) dressed in simple robes stands watching intently.
